zIndex.$description: Stacking-order layering scale. Ordered integers with generous gaps so new layers can be inserted between existing ones without renumbering. Consumers should reference these instead of hardcoding z-index per platform to avoid overlap bugs (e.g. a toast under a modal, a tooltip clipped by a sticky header).

hide.$description: Send an element behind the base layer

sticky.$description: Sticky headers, toolbars, and pinned rows

popover.$description: Popovers and context menus above modals
